stem: On what basis is trade broadly classified into internal trade and external trade?
options: Size of the transactions involved
Location of buyers and sellers
Nature of the goods being traded
Mode of payment used by buyers
explanation: Correct option: (B). Trade is classified as internal or external on the basis of the geographical location of buyers and sellers: within one country it is internal trade, between countries it is external trade. Transaction size separates wholesale from retail, not internal from external; the nature of goods and the mode of payment are not the basis of this classification.
